authorized_input_format: saved JSON only; no HDF5/NPZ/source arrays or scientific helpers
counting_unit: logical profiles/members/triples; 61 geometry aliases and shared controls remain correlated
existing_example_selection: Only original display rank2; all three original members and all six saved scan metric objects copied unchanged. No new ordering.
limitations: Posthoc same2017visit, ON-selected and correlated; counts are descriptive not probabilities/veto/FAP or independent validation.
Fixed moving OFF paths can miss nearby stationary OFF structure; OFF signs do not prove absence/origin.
No robust detector score is subtracted from or equated with profile means.
No data-adaptive threshold, ranking, refit, consensus, calibrated SNR/flux/sensitivity or origin classification.
logical_member_rules: any of three OFF means >= same member original originON mean
all three OFF means >= same member original originON mean
any fixed adjacentOFF mean >= same member original originON mean
all fixed adjacentOFF means >= same member original originON mean
mean_sign_definition: mean > 0, exact float comparison with zero; zero and negative counted separately
triple_histograms: number of three positive original-originON means (0..3)
number of members with anyOFF mean >= own originalON mean (0..3)
number of members with allOFF means positive (0..3)
